column5: UI is built and routed, but ★ FIVE house-edge numbers exist and the one players see is wrong. Client MinesGame.tsx:150 floors at *98 (2%); the live POINTS rail _shared/mines.ts:126 uses MINES_EDGE_BPS=9500 (5%); the legacy game-settlement:1708 defaults 0.05 and no call site overrides it (5%); gridGamesService.ts:334 has a dead 0.02; and the ADMIN config mines_house_edge defaults 0.03 and is read by NOTHING, so changing it in the admin panel does nothing. Player is quoted ~2.8-2.9% high at bet-sizing time then silently corrected mid-round: at 3 mines / 3 reveals the panel quotes 1.46x and the server pays 1.4188x, so a 1,000-point stake returns 42 points less than shown. ★ ALSO grid size is silently dropped - MinesGame passes gridSize but pointsGameService.ts never forwards it, so picking 36/49/64 gives a 25-tile SERVER board behind a larger client board and tiles >=25 fail with an opaque "Failed to reveal tile". ★ ALSO a second live Mines UI, MinefieldPro.tsx, is still mounted in Play.tsx and PlayNewReleases.tsx with the same 2% hardcode under a comment falsely claiming it matches the server. Figma parity NOT yet assessed - this is code-vs-code drift found by the 275 sweep
